_comment: Inputs of folly's generic HookOS UKI, which .github/workflows/talos-images.yml signs. hookos is a tinkerbell/hook release and the sha512 of its hook_latest-lts-x86_64.tar.gz, as its checksum.txt lists it; Renovate bumps both together. The containers workflow's delivery rewrites tink_agent_image when images/tink-agent-autoid builds.
